description: Analyze the first qualifying purchase only after order identity, refund handling, currency and cohort windows are explicit.

guide.applicability: Use for a bounded cohort when the project has a reviewed first-purchase semantic binding.
guide.context_boundary: A returned order is not automatically a qualifying first purchase, and missing history prevents lifetime-first claims.
steps: Resolve qualifying order, refund, currency, user identity and cohort-window semantics.
Query the exact returned event metric and group only by approved cohort dimensions.
Report returned cohort observations and history gaps without claiming complete lifetime-first coverage.
guide.title: First-purchase cohort observation

summary: Describe returned first-purchase cohorts under one project-owned definition.
